thread:
Evan M.: Heads-up: I sketched a one-page 'Provisioning & Rollout Cheatsheet' for dedicated capacity. Trying to keep it super actionable w/ CLI/SDK snippets and a short troubleshooting matrix. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210 :page_with_curl:
Priya S.: Love the idea. Can you add an explicit note that "isolation_preference" is advisory and does not bypass tenant priority? A single sentence is fine.
Evan M.: Added the advisory sentence and a tiny example showing `isolation_preference: \"reserved\"` in the YAML snippet.
Kai L.: Can we include a quick code example that shows how to attach a scale policy to the reserved pool (so customers don't starve it)? A one-liner would be enough.
Evan M.: Added this Terraform one-liner under the 'Prevent pool starvation' section: ```hcl
resource "redwood_scale_policy" "gold" {
  pool = "gold-reserved"
  min_instances = 2
}
```
eng-platform: Suggest adding the 15m quiet promotion window and a note about temporarily routing a small % of traffic first. Also recommend an airflow-freeze during promotion for latency-sensitive tenants.
Evan M.: Included the 15m quiet window and a short bullet: "Mirror 5-10% traffic for 1-2 hours before full promotion". Also added an 'Airflow freeze' row in the checklist.
Priya S.: Docs nit: under 'SLA callouts' please make it explicit that preemptible pools are excluded from the standard 99th latency SLA and link to the SLA legal page.
Evan M.: Done — linked to /docs/legal/sla and added a suggested sentence for legal to reuse.
Kai L.: Added a short note about quantized-model cold-starts on older GPUs (~200-400ms) and that this may affect initial latency checks during the quiet window.
Evan M.: Added the quantization parenthetical and a small streaming-retry example for JS clients. Snippet: ```js
// on stream disconnect, backoff then resume
stream.on('close', async () => {
  await sleep(250);
  client.stream.start({resumeFrom: lastOffset});
});
```
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210 (Evan M.)  reviewers requested: @Priya S., @Kai L.
Priya S.: Tiny link fix: change link that pointed to /docs/old-migration to /docs/operational/eviction-behavior.
Evan M.: Fixed link. Added a 2-row troubleshooting matrix: symptom -> immediate checks (quota, label mismatch, insufficient pool capacity, KMS perms).
Kai L.: LGTM apart from maybe adding a short 'rollback steps' bullet (how to demote a pool quickly).
Evan M.: Added rollback steps: 1) stop promotion, 2) route traffic back to previous pool, 3) scale down reserved pool, 4) open incident if eviction spike persists.
Priya S.: Okay from docs POV. Tagging legal + eng-runtime for final sign-offs before merge.
Evan M.: Thanks. Scheduling a 10-min SIG-docs quick review tomorrow morning. :alarm_clock:
